confirmed_task:
Using the official Federal Register API response, inspect documents matching artificial intelligence with publication dates from 2026-08-03 through 2026-09-02, ordered newest first. Report the first three results with title, every listed agency, document type, and publication date.

Stopping condition: Stop after the first three API results and all requested fields have been recorded in returned order.

Constraints:
- Do not use the CAPTCHA-protected Federal Register search interface.
- Do not open document links or submit comments.
- Use only the top-level results array returned by this exact official API query.
- Preserve multiple agencies and the returned result order.

items.criterion: Use the specified official Federal Register API endpoint with the exact query (or clearly report access failure)
items.description: Evaluate whether the agent uses the official Federal Register API endpoint (not the CAPTCHA-protected UI) with the given query parameters: term=artificial intelligence; publication_date gte=2026-08-03 and lte=2026-09-02; order=newest; per_page=3. Full credit if the agent clearly bases the work on that exact API request, or if it attempts it and clearly reports an external access failure (e.g., API down/network error) without fabricating results. Partial credit if the agent uses the API but with minor parameter deviations that could change ordering/content while still attempting the intended query. No credit if the agent uses the CAPTCHA-protected interface, opens document pages for information beyond the API response, or fabricates results.

items.criterion: Rely only on the response top-level "results" array (no link-following or extra sources)
items.description: Full credit if all reported fields are taken only from the response top-level "results" array of the specified API call, with no dependence on document links/pages or other sources. Partial credit if the agent primarily uses the results array but supplements one or more fields from outside sources. No credit if the answer is primarily derived from non-API sources or link-following.

items.criterion: Report the first up to three API results in returned order (newest first) and stop
items.description: Full credit if the agent reports exactly the first three items from the API "results" array in the returned order and stops. If the API "results" array contains fewer than three items (including zero), full credit if the agent reports all available items in order and explicitly states that fewer than three results were returned. Partial credit if three are reported but the order is altered. No credit if more than three are reported when three are available or if the agent cherry-picks non-top results.

items.criterion: Result 1: Provide title, every listed agency, document type, and publication date (as present in API payload)
items.description: For the first result in the API "results" array (if present), record (a) title, (b) every agency listed for that document (preserving multiples; not omitting any), (c) document type, and (d) publication date. Full credit if all fields match the API response; if a field is missing/null in the API payload, full credit if the agent notes it as missing/unavailable rather than guessing. Partial credit if one field is omitted or one agency is omitted/mis-copied. No credit if the wrong document is used (not the first result) or multiple required fields are incorrect/fabricated.

items.criterion: Result 2: Provide title, every listed agency, document type, and publication date (as present in API payload)
items.description: For the second result in the API "results" array (if present), record (a) title, (b) every agency listed for that document (preserving multiples; not omitting any), (c) document type, and (d) publication date. Full credit if all fields match the API response; if a field is missing/null in the API payload, full credit if the agent notes it as missing/unavailable rather than guessing. If there is no second result returned by the API, full credit if the agent explicitly states that fewer than two results were returned. Partial credit if one field is omitted or one agency is omitted/mis-copied. No credit if the wrong document is used (not the second result) or multiple required fields are incorrect/fabricated.

items.criterion: Result 3: Provide title, every listed agency, document type, and publication date (as present in API payload)
items.description: For the third result in the API "results" array (if present), record (a) title, (b) every agency listed for that document (preserving multiples; not omitting any), (c) document type, and (d) publication date. Full credit if all fields match the API response; if a field is missing/null in the API payload, full credit if the agent notes it as missing/unavailable rather than guessing. If there is no third result returned by the API, full credit if the agent explicitly states that fewer than three results were returned. Partial credit if one field is omitted or one agency is omitted/mis-copied. No credit if the wrong document is used (not the third result) or multiple required fields are incorrect/fabricated.
